overview_description.description:
Macromedia was a North American graphics and Web development software house headquartered in San Francisco, California producing such products as Macromedia Flash.

The line of Macromedia products is now controlled by its former rival, Adobe Systems, which acquired Macromedia on December 3, 2005.
